user_query: I want to buy a new pair of headphones. Can you help me find the best offers available for headphones? I'm looking for a specific brand and model, so please provide me with the product details and reviews as well.

TaskList.description: Search for the specified brand and model of headphones.
Retrieve the best offers and prices for the searched headphones.
Collect product details for the selected headphones, including specifications.
Check for user reviews and ratings for the selected headphones.
